discussion.body:
Stack has changed again when moving to ChatGPT Astra model. UE5-Blender. UI elements still in discussion. 3D Model/Obj creation in discussion - But artistically, we want Octopath traveler.
→ 3D environments → 2D character sprites/billboards → dynamic lighting and sprite/environment shadows → Niagara effects → post-processing, bloom, fog and depth-of-field → Blueprint for rapid gameplay/system iteration → C++ where Astra needs deeper systems/performance → Blender for environments/props → ChatGPT for image concepting and Afinity for production sprites. Additional discussion for animation techniques. What is industry standard.
